# سبأ للعطور | Sabascents

> Original Arabian perfume store in Türkiye (Istanbul). Order on WhatsApp +905377188486 or Instagram @sabascents. Prices in Turkish lira. 155 products from 11 brands. Site languages: Arabic (/), English (/en/), Turkish (/tr/), Russian (/ru/).

A Saudi brand with numbered releases and names inspired by places in Saudi Arabia.
